'Go again / At the beginning of your action phase, destroy this, then the next Guardian attack action card you play this turn gets +3{p}.' Guardian Action - Aura (BravoHeroDeck).

GO AGAIN NOT AUTHORED: GoAgain is in printed_keywords as an UNCONDITIONAL line of the text, so it fires from the card DB keywords field; re-authoring it would be a defect. No SOURCE_IS_ATTACK conditional-keyword machinery applies (nothing gates it).

SHAPE copied verbatim from .drafts/emerging_power_yellow.json - same card, other printing; only the pump amount differs (+2 there, +3 here). The yellow draft's claims were checked against source this session: START_OF_ACTION_PHASE is mapped at trigger_types.py:58 for exactly this CR 4.3.1 wording, and the engine listener dispatches it to the ACTIVE player's permanent zones including player.auras (engine.py:1514-1522), so the aura fires on its controller's own action phase - 'your action phase'; no IS_ACTIVE_PLAYER gate needed.

EFFECT ORDER follows the printed sentence: DESTROY_SELF first (effect_types.py:2470 shares the DESTROY_PERMANENT branch; bare form destroys the source via canonical destroy(), which resolves the aura zone itself), then MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK queues on the controller's dsl_queued_attack_mods (handler effect_types.py:4592-4618 READS mod/amount/filter/scope - verified this session). Destroying the aura first cannot unqueue the pump: the entry lives on the player, not the card. One-shot consumption by the first qualifying attack IS 'the next'; unused entries expire end of turn, which is 'this turn' (scope left at default TURN).

FILTER names 'Guardian attack action card': ATTACK_CLASS_IN reads 'classes' (Guardian is class/talent), ATTACK_TYPE_IN reads 'types' (Action), ATTACK_SUBTYPE_IN reads 'subtypes' (Attack) - all three documented in DSL_REFERENCE.md's MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK filter table with these exact keys.
